title: Google Scholar Scraper
description: Google Scholar Scraper collects structured data from Scrappa's /google/scholar endpoint. Submit multiple inputs in one Actor run and receive one dataset item per result. Submit multiple batch entries in one run.

queries.title: Queries
queries.description: Batch input entries. Each q is sent as the q value.

q.title: Q
q.description: Scholar search query. Optional when cites or cluster is supplied.

hl.title: HL
hl.description: Two-letter interface language, optionally with a region. Defaults to en.

start.title: Start
start.description: Zero-based result offset from 0 to 990. Defaults to 0.

num.title: NUM
num.description: Results per request from 1 to 20. Defaults to 10.

scisbd.title: Scisbd
scisbd.description: 0 for relevance, 1 for recent abstracts, or 2 for all recent additions.

cites.title: Cites
cites.description: Numeric publication ID for a cited-by search. May be combined with q.

cluster.title: Cluster
cluster.description: Numeric publication ID for an all-versions search. Must be used alone.
